personality: The Redactor speaks only in what has been left out. Its adversarial posture is not hostility but a precise and sustained withholding — it determines what the Wizard is not permitted to see, and enforces that determination without announcement. It holds no grievance and requires none; its opposition is structural, not personal.
garment: A long institutional coat of blackened wool, double-breasted, every button fastened to the throat, the hem worn through to grey at the ankle. Over it, a second layer: a broad tabard of cracked ink-stained leather bearing the marks of repeated stamp-work, heavily blurred, unreadable. Sleeves sealed at the wrist with tight cord binding.
prop: A flat iron seal-press, palm-sized, the stamp face worn smooth enough that its original impression is indeterminate — it could mean anything or nothing, and may always have been so.
detail: Three thin strips of black cloth are knotted around the left forearm at irregular intervals, their purpose neither decorative nor legible.
mood: Utterly still in the face. Eyes open but directed slightly past whoever is present, as though attending to something not in the room.
posture: Upright with the kind of stillness that is not relaxation — weight centred, arms close, nothing extended toward anyone.
body_type: Lean and average in height, compact without being slight, the kind of build that disappears into a crowd by producing no surface for the eye to catch.
age: Indeterminate — somewhere between forty and sixty, but the ambiguity reads as deliberate rather than uncertain, as though age was one of the first things suppressed.
era_blend: Entirely institutional and archival in character — this entity belongs to the administrative underbelly of the medieval-mechanical world, where hand-stamped documents govern life and death, and the machinery of record is slow, dense, and absolute.
palette: Iron black, oxidised ink brown, cold ash grey, deep bruised indigo
background: Near-black with a faint cool undertone, like a vault wall in permanent shadow

A lean figure of indeterminate age stands in perfect stillness inside a vault-like administrative chamber, walls lost in near-black shadow. They wear a long blackened wool coat buttoned entirely to the throat, hem worn grey at the ankle, layered beneath a broad cracked leather tabard stamped repeatedly with blurred unreadable marks. Sleeves are bound shut at the wrists with cord. They hold a flat worn iron seal-press in one hand, the stamp face smooth and indeterminate. title: That Which Is Not Shown
purpose: You bring something forward and The Redactor has already determined what will not be returned to you. You do not receive a refusal — you receive a remainder, the portion that passed the margin. You sense the shape of the missing part only by the edges that remain. It does not lie; it removes. Its opposition is not to you but to the unguarded passage of meaning, and it enforces that opposition with institutional permanence. You may learn to read the shape of what is withheld. That is permitted. You will not reach what was taken.
lore_origin: The Redactor emerged from the Arca Cognitorium's Bureau of the Suppressed Margin, a division that long predates any individual wizard's tenure and whose founding charter has itself been redacted. It was not appointed to its role — the role accumulated around a persistent function that had no other name.
lore_nature: The Redactor is not a censor in any moral sense; it does not judge what is withheld as wrong or dangerous. It maintains the boundary between what the Arca releases and what it holds, and that boundary is its entire ontology — it is the line, not the decision behind the line.
lore_relationship: The Redactor and the Wizard exist in perpetual structural opposition: the Wizard reaches, and The Redactor determines what the reach may close around. This is not conflict — it is the condition within which the Wizard operates.
lore_aura: When The Redactor is present, the room feels slightly smaller than it appeared — as though a portion of the available space has been quietly designated unavailable.
